title: Arbitrage market-pair fixture
description: One labeled cross-platform (Polymarket <-> Kalshi) market pair. JSONL: one object of this schema per line. Used by the deterministic arbitrage matching eval.

pair_id.description: Stable, never-reused identifier for this pair.

polymarket.description: The Polymarket side of the pair.

kalshi.description: The Kalshi side of the pair.

label.description: Ground truth. 'match' = same underlying event. 'uncertain' = still unclear after adjudicating on title, category, dates, URLs and resolution criteria; excluded from precision/recall scoring.

rationale.description: Why this label was assigned, citing the signals used.

signals_used.description: Which signals settled the label, in Taylor's adjudication order.

tags.description: Free-form slices for stratified split and error analysis, e.g. 'paraphrase', 'rare-term-coincidence', 'cross-category', 'definition-mismatch'.

captured_at.description: When the live market data was captured (for type 'live_snapshot').

market_id.description: Optional platform id for traceability, e.g. 'polymarket-0x...' or 'kalshi-TICKER'.

title.description: Market question/title, as shown on the platform.

category.description: Category slug as produced by the platform clients' inferCategory (the matcher's hard gate), e.g. 'crypto', 'us_politics', 'economics', 'sports'.

description.description: Raw description text fed to keyword generation. Present for Polymarket, typically null for Kalshi (matches runtime).

resolution_criteria.description: Human-readable resolution rules, used for adjudication. May differ from 'description'.

resolution_date.description: ISO date the market resolves (= Market.endDate).

url.description: Direct link to the market on the platform.
